bugs.error_message: 注销账号后显示'服务器格式不正确'，注销失败
bugs.root_cause: api_delete_user 密码错误时返回 HTTP 403，HarmonyOS http 模块对非 2xx 响应返回 ArrayBuffer 而非 string，导致 CloudService postJson 中 JSON.parse 失败，返回 '服务器响应格式错误'
bugs.fix: 删除 return jsonify({...}), 403 中的 403 状态码，改为默认 200，确保 HarmonyOS http 返回 string 类型响应体

bugs.error_message: rtk failed to run rg/cat and one nested PowerShell command lost quoting
bugs.root_cause: The Windows RTK wrapper could not resolve cat, returned access denied for rg, and outer PowerShell expanded nested command syntax
bugs.fix: Use rtk proxy powershell.exe with simple commands and literal paths; avoid nested variables and regex-heavy quoting

bugs.error_message: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'flask' while running test_wenxin_proxy.py
bugs.root_cause: The available MSYS2 Python runtime does not have the Flask production dependency installed
bugs.fix: Load the real target function from wenxin_proxy.py via Python AST so the unit test stays dependency-free

bugs.error_message: AI lastFallDaysAgo used the oldest fall record as the latest record
bugs.root_cause: MqttManager prepends new records, but WenxinService read falls[falls.length - 1]
bugs.fix: Read falls[0], matching the newest-first record order used by MqttManager and the UI

bugs.error_message: 00303217 Configuration Error: Invalid value of 'DEVECO_SDK_HOME' in the system environment path
bugs.root_cause: Hvigor was not on PATH and its process did not receive the installed DevEco SDK location
bugs.fix: Run DevEco's bundled node/hvigorw.js with process-local DEVECO_SDK_HOME=E:\DevEco Studio\sdk

bugs.root_cause: The local SSH configuration rewrote the default port to 6022 when no explicit port was supplied
bugs.fix: Pass -p 22 explicitly; root authentication then succeeded and returned hostname ecs-f195

bugs.error_message: Permission denied, please try again while inspecting ECS process environment
bugs.root_cause: A later read-only SSH session rejected the supplied password twice after earlier sessions had authenticated successfully
bugs.fix: Stopped retries to avoid account lockout; rely on the already confirmed process/path/port and require environment checks before restart

bugs.error_message: curl: (35) schannel: failed to receive handshake, SSL/TLS connection failed
bugs.root_cause: The local Windows curl TLS handshake failed while fetching the Codex manual
bugs.fix: Installed the official OpenAI Developer Docs MCP and used an official-domain web search for the bounded check

bugs.error_message: [mcporter] Unable to load tool metadata; name positional arguments explicitly
bugs.root_cause: The mcporter invocation could not resolve the Exa tool metadata from the positional call syntax
bugs.fix: Stopped using that invocation and queried official OpenAI domains through the available web search tool

bugs.error_message: rtk: Failed to resolve 'Get-Content' via PATH
bugs.root_cause: Get-Content is a PowerShell cmdlet, not a standalone executable that RTK can resolve directly
bugs.fix: Invoke powershell.exe through rtk proxy and run Get-Content inside PowerShell

bugs.root_cause: Nested PowerShell quoting broke the JavaScript string literal
bugs.fix: Use a JavaScript template literal for commands containing nested quoted PowerShell paths

bugs.error_message: The term '=' is not recognized as the name of a cmdlet
bugs.root_cause: The outer PowerShell expanded $null inside a double-quoted child command before powershell.exe received it
bugs.fix: Avoid variables in nested double-quoted PowerShell commands and pipe directly to Out-Null

bugs.error_message: rtk: Failed to execute command: rg: Access is denied (os error 5)
bugs.root_cause: The RTK wrapper could not execute the resolved rg binary in this Windows environment
bugs.fix: Use git diff and PowerShell read-only verification commands instead of RTK-wrapped rg for this check

bugs.error_message: ConvertFrom-Json: Invalid object passed in, ':' or '}' expected
bugs.root_cause: The existing bug log already contains malformed legacy JSON before the newly appended entries
bugs.fix: Kept the new entries structurally valid and left the unrelated legacy corruption untouched for a dedicated repair

bugs.error_message: Missing type name after '[' in nested PowerShell slice command
bugs.root_cause: The outer PowerShell expanded the child $lines variable before the nested command executed
bugs.fix: Use variable-free Get-Content pipelines with Select-Object and single-quoted child commands

bugs.error_message: Select-String rejected a pattern with an illegal trailing backslash
bugs.root_cause: Nested quoting changed the intended regular expression before Select-String parsed it
bugs.fix: Use rtk git grep for tracked source searches and avoid regex-heavy nested PowerShell quoting

bugs.error_message: Claude-mem inspection hit an incorrect skill path, RTK rg access denial, and nested PowerShell quoting errors
bugs.root_cause: The first command assumed the wrong skill-root path, while later commands repeated known Windows RTK rg and nested PowerShell quoting limitations
bugs.fix: Use the explicit plugin cache path, run file inspection through rtk proxy powershell, and pass variable-bearing child commands in single quotes

bugs.error_message: GitHub CLI required authentication and Agent Reach curl fallback returned FAILED while reading the Repomix repository
bugs.root_cause: The local gh client had no authenticated account and the RTK-wrapped curl route did not return page content
bugs.fix: Opened the public official GitHub repository through the web fetch route and verified the README there

bugs.error_message: aistar.asia 官网发信全部失败：wp-mail-smtp 的 from_email 是占位值 admin@exmaple.com，且 from_email_force=1
bugs.root_cause: 安装向导留下的示例地址（还带拼写错误 exmaple）未改；QQ SMTP 要求 From 与认证账号一致，强制覆盖后每封信都被服务端拒绝
bugs.fix: 把 mail.from_email 改为 smtp.user（1622828551@qq.com），wp_mail() 自检返回 true

bugs.error_message: aistar.asia 窄屏下整页横向溢出 6px（document.scrollWidth 381 > clientWidth 375）
bugs.root_cause: 图片宽度用了 max-width:min(560px,90vw)。vw 单位按含滚动条的视口宽度计算（viewport 390，clientWidth 只有 375），90vw=351px 超出内容区，撑出横向滚动条
bugs.fix: 图片尺寸改用 width:100% + max-width:<px>，容器负责约束，彻底不用 vw
